note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Lisburn rural district. Three divisions were contested at the poll of Thursday 5 June 1924 and declared on 6 June; the News-Letter's report prints only those three, so the uncontested divisions are not listed here. A separate note of 10 May 1924 records that the Derriaghy contest fell through because the nomination of James Coey was informal. Armstrong (re-elected), 282; Dawson (Labour), 67.
